boundaryRate.interpretation: millions means at least 2000000 distinct fully materialized and evaluated input permutations per second in every measured trial
boundaryRate.inputKind: four-field integer event fixture: event ordering, sequence gap, bounded allocation size, checksum byte
boundaryRate.productionScope: full distributed micro-world target remains unmeasured

gradientFuzzing.success: concrete rounded integer reaches exact equality after traversing nested range guards

relaxation.note: smooth candidate-output loss; no claim of differentiating actual wall-clock latency

lora.revisionPolicy: resolve once before download; record immutable revision and all downloaded file SHA256 digests
lora.selection: final step only; heldout examples never select hyperparameters or checkpoint
acceptance: save and fresh-model reload preserve heldout logits within 0.0001
lora.quality: report heldout loss before and after without requiring an improvement or claiming synthesis competence
